title: GM Composition Recipes & GCL Integration
objective: Define original deterministic GM composition recipes and bounded reference-based integration with completed GCL-01..12 libraries over frozen MAL-01..06 contracts, without recreating GCL discovery/composition-engine authority or creating canonical owner-domain truth.

rules: MAL-07 consumes frozen MAL-01..06 contracts and authorized references into completed GCL-01..12 library records. It does not copy, fork, flatten or silently reinterpret GCL library authority.

Recipe definitions are explicit, ordered and deterministic. The same recipe definition, authorized GCL references, MAL-local state and logical tick produce the same bindings, recipe state and deterministic receipt.
GCL integration is reference-based only. Missing, unknown, hidden, unauthorized or not-yet-completed GCL records remain unresolved and are never inferred.

MAL-07 does not implement GCL-16 discovery/recommendation, GCL-17 Composition Engine Design, or any later GCL tranche. It may not search hidden libraries, rank secret choices or auto-compose from unavailable records.

GM composition recipes may bind GCL construction references to MAL primitives and Aniloops for local presentation/use, but may not launch sessions/adventures/campaigns or commit canonical Travel, Character/NPC, World/Scene, Action/Event, Project/progression, Inventory/Asset, Combat, reward or Permission truth.
Recipe validation may report missing references, incompatible local step kinds and unresolved visibility, but may not mutate GCL records or owner-domain state.

AI may propose a recipe only from explicitly authorized visible references and MAL-local inputs. AI cannot invent hidden GCL records, choose secret outcomes, commit canonical consequences or bypass Permission/visibility.
forbidden: copying or vendoring GCL library payloads into parallel MAL authority
implementation of GCL-13+ unfinished content as though completed
automatic hidden-library search, ranking or secret recommendation
canonical Travel, Character/NPC, World/Scene, Action/Event, Project/progression, Inventory/Asset, Combat, reward or Permission mutation
hidden-data reveal or unauthorized owner/GCL-state inference

invalidation_events: relevant AIOC MAL/GCL authority or checkpoint change
required validation reports a materially new failure signature

validation_requirement: Exactly one MAL-07 current-family profile, zero historical predecessor fanout, genuine matching self-hosted Linux/Windows acceptance RED before production mutation, then exact-head Linux/Windows GREEN and deterministic comparison.
